# Fix flawed heuristic for user communication (2025-06-23 02:42Z)

Fix this bug...

The heuristic for determining if a specialist agent handled user communication is flawed. It uses an arbitrary 50-character threshold (`result.len() > 50`) which misclassifies responses: short, meaningful messages (e.g., "File saved successfully") are marked as unhandled, leading to redundant orchestrator TTS feedback. Conversely, long, non-meaningful outputs (e.g., error messages or status outputs) are marked as handled, preventing necessary orchestrator feedback. Additionally, the `!result.trim().is_empty()` check within this condition is redundant and could incorrectly classify long strings of whitespace as user communication. This results in inconsistent or confusing user feedback.
